rights_specific: Copyright of four distinct original DigFlora/KR photos not affirmatively cleared for public redistribution; author photo and taxon credit verified.
rights_nuance: https://w3.biosci.utexas.edu/prc/Monocots/ expressly permits scientific and educational reuse of Selected Monocots images, but is limited by wording to that separately curated subset. It is NOT a blanket rights grant for these DigFlora/KR original files.

scientific_comparison.ligule_variation: FNA 0.5–2 mm; Kew GrassBase 1–3 mm eciliate membrane; another SDSU educational source describes fringed membrane less than 2.5 mm. Do not demand hair-fringed membrane in every same-species plant or state 0.5–2.5mm absolute.
scientific_comparison.spikelet_pairs: Author A/F/P and FNA agree that pairs consist of fertile sessile + usually reduced but variably developed sterile or staminate pedicellate spikelets. Upper spikelet/floret structures must not be incorrectly conflated.
scientific_comparison.reproductive_caution: The sessile spikelet contains upper bisexual fertile floret and lower sterile floret, enclosed by two glumes; detached glumes/lemmas/palea on author image are separately placed parts, not visually joined from one voucher.
scientific_comparison.hays_plant_scope: North Hays local source identity strongly documented; no single collection number demonstrates that photographs from root, ligule, attached pair, dissection all come from same plant.
scientific_comparison.invasive_split: Little bluestem has mostly separate short leaf-branch racemes; Texas KR bluestem has several longer narrow fingers from terminal cluster. Not a single-node-hair or color-only split.
